headline: Reddit launches AI-powered product reviews from user conversations
summary: Reddit launched an AI-powered product reviews feature that summarizes real user sentiment from across its communities for about 10,000 products.

claims.statement: Reddit launched AI-generated product reviews summarizing user sentiment for about 10,000 products.

sources.quote: Reddit launches AI-powered Reviews feature – with 10,000 products to start
Reddit is adding AI-generated product reviews that compile real user sentiment from across communities.
Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews
Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.
Reddit is (sort of) getting into the product reviews business
